crm_notes:
High-pace IDE plugin vendor focused on enterprise developer velocity. Primary ask: deterministic, reproducible code completions for code-reviewable patches and CI gating. Wants strong model/version pinning and a repeatable canary/rollout workflow.

Summary from 2026-02-14 call w/ CTO (L. Moreno): 'We can't push models that produce nondeterministic refactors — auditing and revertability are critical.' Interested in model-hash pinning, pinned quantized variants for cost, and easy rollback.

AE notes: team is sensitive to regressions in code correctness. Currently evaluating Redwood + a secondary provider for redundancy. POC to run against 3 internal repos (frontend, platform, infra). CTO asked for clear eval gates and automatic rollback triggers integrated into CI.

CSM note: prefer Dedicated for predictable latency initially; may move to Private if data residency/legal demands arise. Keep pricing expectations aligned with $50k-$250k ARR band.

Shorthand / fragments common in notes: "needs seed control for completions", "golden prompts/tests", "canary w/ 50 devs -> then 20% customers", "audit log retention 1yr", "want SDK hook for model pin assignment per repo".
technical_requirements: Low-latency streaming in-IDE, target p95 token latency <80ms
Model/version pinning by immutable model hash and semantic aliasing (eg repo@commit-like pin)
Support for quantized variants + fallback to full-precision when quality gate fails
Deterministic run mode / fixed seed for reproducible completions in CI
Eval gates: unit-test style prompt suites, golden-output matching, pass/fail thresholds
Telemetry: token-level cost breakdown, diffs of outputs vs baseline, rollout tracing
Canary routing: percent-based, per-team/per-repo targeting, automatic rollback triggers
KV/prefix caching for repeated contexts; must be configurable per workspace
poc_scope: 3-week technical POC running on Dedicated pool (small reserved capacity)
Run reproducibility suite against 200 golden prompts across three repos
Canary rollout: 50 internal devs -> measure regression rate and latency impact
Integrate model pinning in CI: deploy model hash in pipeline to verify deterministic outputs
Collect telemetry to prove cost per completion vs incumbent (baseline provided by customer)
evaluation_metrics: Deterministic match rate >= 99% for fixed-seed runs
Token cost <= baseline + 10% (with quantized fallback considered)
No critical security findings in infra/VPC review
rollout_plan: Stage 0: internal dev-only canary (50 devs) for 2 weeks
Stage 1: invite-only beta for 20% of active customers (A/B with control)
Stage 2: gradual ramp to 100% with monitoring and auto-rollback on regression triggers
Eval gates enforced at CI: automated checks must pass before a model alias can be promoted
Automatic fallback to pinned quantized-compatible model variant if throughput spike or cost SLO breached
